versions.content: Naming convention for global variables All global variables defined by the BSW Module shall be labeled according to the following: <Mip>_<Vn> Where <Mip> is the Module implementation prefix of the BSW Module ( SWS_BSW_00102 ) and <Vn> is the Variable name , which shall be written in camel c ase .
